assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome
occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease
The diagnoses are I47.1, I25.10, I49.5
Due to the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
a cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to capture arrhythmic episodes during daily activities
The CPT code for the cardiac event monitoring study is 93271
The payer's denial under Reason Code CO-97 indicates payment for this service is bundled into another covered procedure
the intermittent, symptom-correlated nature of this patient's supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome demonstrates a distinct medical necessity not otherwise captured
